messages:
Emma Li: weekly health check - error breakdown (5xx/timeouts/429). Putting top endpoints and per-account notes here.

Jake Park: dashboard -> https://console.redwood.ai/d/health/weekly-errors?range=7d

Emma Li: snapshot: global 5xx increased 2.1pp w/w; timeouts up mostly on /v1/stream and long-gen routes; 429s concentrated on /v1/embeddings/ingest.

Avery Nguyen: Account: GreenFleet
Avery Nguyen: Symptoms: 5xx jump from 1.2% -> 4.6%; spike around 2026-03-16 22:00Z during large route planning runs.
Avery Nguyen: Top failing endpoints:
- /v1/generate (60% of 5xx): model shard OOM when customers submit 3 concurrent long-gen requests
- /v1/stream (25%): websocket disconnects/timeouts mid-stream
- /v1/embeddings/ingest (10%): partial failures during retry storms

Priya Rao: infra note: we saw model eviction thrashing on the pool serving GreenFleet; likely kernel allocation regression after recent kernel-swap. Recommend pinning model variant to quant-stable for this pool.

Oliver Martinez: Dedicated ticket DF-2207 opened; applied temporary pool size increase for GreenFleet to reduce contention.

Maria Kim: Account: ZenLedger
Maria Kim: Symptoms: 429s up 8x on /v1/embeddings/ingest due to nightly reconciliation jobs hitting hot path.
Maria Kim: Guidance sent: stagger ingestion windows, shard keys, and obey recommended batch size <=256.

Jake Park: Global hotspots summary:
- /v1/embeddings/ingest => ~70% of 429s, mostly automated ingestion clients
- /v1/stream?mode=long => elevated timeouts (client idle timeouts)

Jake Park: gateway temp override for CS to share:
```
route: /v1/embeddings/ingest
rate_limit: 10000/min
burst: 300
```

Priya Rao: monitoring updates: adding 30m rolling alert for /v1/stream timeouts >1.5% and hourly 5xx alert for /v1/generate >2.5%. Also scheduling a synthetic long-stream test against canary pool.

deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-03-16T21:54:10Z - kernel-swap-3 -> us-east-1 (release id: r-20260316-k3)

Emma Li: Action items:
1) Eng (Priya) - pin GreenFleet pool to quant-stable and run 5k synthetic long-gen tests (ETA: 12:00 PST tomorrow)
2) Ops (Jake) - deploy gateway temp caps and add alerts (ETA: EOD PST)
3) CS (Maria/Avery) - send enablement note to GreenFleet/ZenLedger with batching & retry guidance; confirm ZenLedger will stagger next job (ETA: next business day)
4) Dedicated (Oliver) - follow DF-2207 and report back

Jake Park: ack. will add alerts + gateway patch.
Priya Rao: ack. will schedule canary tests and pin configs.
Oliver Martinez: ack. DF-2207 updated.
Maria Kim: will confirm ZenLedger schedule shift and report.

Emma Li: thanks team. I'll include this in the weekly deck and ping AM to close follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
